author: Hussain Nasser
headline: Venture building × AI × games in Saudi Arabia | PE & M&A modelling and valuation | Portfolio Manager, Revival Lab | Investment Director, Glo
text: The first edition of Gulf Deal Notes is out. This week: China clears Savvy's Moonton deal, PIF and Silver Lake's reported look at Unity, and what's under Saudi VC's nine-month number. One short read a week on where Gulf money goes, at home and abroad.

author: Hussain Nasser
headline: Venture building × AI × games in Saudi Arabia | PE & M&A modelling and valuation | Portfolio Manager, Revival Lab | Investment Director, Glo
text:
China's market regulator has reportedly cleared Savvy Games Group's purchase of Moonton, the studio behind Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. No conditions attached. The deal hasn't closed yet.

ByteDance paid about $4B for Moonton in 2021. This deal is valued at more than $6B.

With Scopely ($4.9B, agreed in 2023), that's more than $10.9B on two mobile games companies.

In both deals the existing management stays in charge. Moonton's CEO Zhang Yunfan stays on.

What I'll watch: the closing announcement.

If you're building mobile games in the region, would you rather sell one day, or stay independent?

Sources: Reuters via Arab News; PocketGamer.biz; Sharikat Mubasher; Variety

author: Hussain Nasser
headline: Venture building × AI × games in Saudi Arabia | PE & M&A modelling and valuation | Portfolio Manager, Revival Lab | Investment Director, Glo
text:
Silver Lake and PIF reportedly discussed buying Unity at about $25B. No deal has been agreed.

That's about 16% above Unity's market cap, and about 24 times its annualised Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $257M.

Two things stand out in Unity's Q3:

1. Ads drive the growth. Grow Solutions rose 44% to $457M. Create, the engine, went to $165M from $152M.

2. Cash. Free cash flow was $220M. On a run-rate, that's about a 3.5% yield at $25B.

What I'll watch: whether Unity confirms a sale process.

Studio founders: do you see Unity more as an engine or an ads business?

Sources: Reuters via PocketGamer.biz and Enterprise AM; Unity Q3 2026 results (SEC filing)
